tagline: Leading provider of proprietary reservoir description and production enhancement services to the global oil and gas industry.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI reflects the company's strategy to focus on high-value-added services, which represent 76% of revenue in 2025. It captures Core Labs' commercial positioning as a provider of proprietary technology solutions rather than commoditized products.

kpis.name: AI / cloud segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from services related to artificial intelligence and cloud computing.
kpis.description: This segment represents the portion of revenue derived from advanced technology solutions for the oil and gas industry, including energy transition projects and potentially AI.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of energy transition and adoption of AI technologies.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales from services and products.
kpis.description: The company's consolidated revenue from its two operating segments: Reservoir Description and Production Enhancement.
kpis.signal: Indicates overall performance of the company in its core markets.

kpis.name: Services share of revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated from services.
kpis.description: The proportion of revenue from services versus product sales, indicating the company's strategy to focus on proprietary technology solutions.

kpis.name: Product sales share of revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated from product sales.
kpis.description: The proportion of revenue from manufactured products produced at the company's four global production facilities.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The total number of employees operating across more than 70 offices in over 50 countries, reflecting the company's operational capacity and global footprint.
kpis.signal: Indicates operational scale and company capacity.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit after deducting direct costs of production or service delivery.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold.
kpis.signal: Indicator of profitability from core operations.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Consolidated operating margin, calculated as operating income divided by revenue.
kpis.signal: Measure of profitability from core activities before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: R&D investments as a percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenditures divided by revenue, showing investment in the future. Core Labs mentions ongoing client-driven R&D activities for reservoir services and technologies.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation and development of new technologies to improve reservoir performance.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to acquiring or upgrading long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures incurred for the purchase or upgrade of fixed assets and laboratory equipment, as well as the four global production facilities.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in future capacity and maintenance of production assets.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer transactions that incorporate solutions or features related to artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: Measures the integration of AI technologies into the company's service and product offerings.
kpis.signal: Early indicator of customer adoption of AI capabilities.

kpis.name: Energy transition service revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from services supporting energy transition projects, such as carbon capture or geothermal projects.
kpis.description: Represents contribution from energy transition-related activities, including carbon capture and storage (CCS), geothermal, and mining evaluation for energy materials, explicitly mentioned in Core Labs' strategy.
kpis.signal: Company positioning in emerging markets related to sustainable energy and carbon emission reduction goals.

risks.title: 10-K filing delay and NYSE non-compliance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in the document with a direct impact on stock exchange compliance (NYSE). The language indicates a risk of delisting if the form is not filed within six months, which constitutes an existential threat. The fact that the filing was made after notification reinforces the severity of the lapse. The Regulation category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Errors in previously published tax information
risks.score_rationale: The correction of a $2.0 million tax adjustment in a prior report (Form 8-K/A) reveals a weakness in financial controls. Although it did not affect revenue or cash flow, it impacts the credibility of financial statements. The language indicates a significant overstatement, and the context following a late filing amplifies the risk of loss of confidence.

risks.title: Unhedged foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple international regions with over 70 offices in more than 50 countries and does not use any derivative instruments to hedge its foreign exchange risks. Gains and losses are directly recorded in earnings. The language is factual but the risk is recurring and unmitigated, making it significant in a context of monetary volatility.

risks.title: Dependence on oil and gas producers' capital expenditures
risks.score_rationale: Demand for Core Labs' services is highly correlated with long-term investment spending trends of oil and gas producers, which in turn depend on commodity prices. The MD&A indicates that periods of low or volatile prices reduce client investments and therefore demand for services.

risks.title: Regulatory risk related to climate and energy policies
risks.score_rationale: The company and its clients are subject to compliance with government regulations related to climate change, energy conservation, and energy transition initiatives. Stricter regulations, carbon taxes, or restrictions on oil and gas production could reduce demand for services.

ai_positioning.summary: CLB does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. The company focuses exclusively on reservoir description and production enhancement services and products for the oil and gas industry.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the Business, MD&A, or Financial Statements sections
Explicit strategy centered on proprietary technologies for reservoir evaluation and energy transition projects (CCS, geothermal, battery materials)
